newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures under harvest/currency pressure.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures under harvest/currency pressure.

text.p: UK grain futures closed lower on Monday with prices under pressure from the harvest, a stronger currency and a lack of buyers.
Wheat futures closed 0.80 to 0.15 stg down, while barley was 0.45 to 0.25 stg lower.
Wheat turnover was 699 lots and barley 66 lots.
In Amsterdam the milling wheat futures contract was neglected.
UK cash traders reported little activity on the fob market and only light delivered buiness.
